title: kb-backlog asks what a push carries when planning a safety check on it
goal: When /kb-backlog breaks down a check that guards a push (publish, a pre-push refusal, a mirror), it asks and records in the goal what the push carries (every commit of the range, not only the final tree), so a hole like BG-rqgmjrq3 (S1, found only at SP-v5xagbyv's review) is in the task's checks from the start
